Frequently asked questions

What is CycloWatt?
CycloWatt is a cleat-based cycling power meter designed for everyday cyclists. It measures real power directly at the shoe and works across multiple bikes.
Is CycloWatt compatible with SPD-SL and Keo Look?
We offer both versions; choose after the campaign.
How is CycloWatt different from other power meters?
Most power meters are mounted to the bike and are expensive or difficult to move between bikes. CycloWatt is mounted on your cleat, installs in seconds, and moves with you - not your bike.
Can I walk on CycloWatt?
Yes, you can walk around without any problems.
How much stack height is added with CycloWatt?
With CycloWatt, 9 mm are added to the normal stack height of a cycling cleat. You can easily offset this by raising your saddle by the same amount, so your riding position stays unchanged.
Is CycloWatt accurate?
Yes. CycloWatt is designed to deliver ±2% accuracy in real-world riding conditions, indoors and outdoors.
Does it feel different from a normal cleat?
No. CycloWatt is engineered to feel like a standard cycling cleat, offering the same secure and stable pedal connection without compromising comfort.
Can I use CycloWatt on multiple bikes?
Yes. Because CycloWatt is installed on your shoe, you can use it on any compatible bike without additional setup.
Is the power meter compatible with MTB?
No, at the current stage, CycloWatt is designed for road cycling.
Does CycloWatt work indoors and outdoors?
Yes. CycloWatt works for both indoor trainer rides and outdoor cycling.
How does CycloWatt connect to my devices?
Power data is transmitted via Bluetooth to your cycling computer or smartphone.
Do I need to install a special app?
No. CycloWatt integrates seamlessly with your existing cycling ecosystem and does not require an additional proprietary app.
Which apps and platforms are supported?
CycloWatt works with major training platforms such as Zwift, Wahoo, Garmin, and other compatible fitness platforms.
How long does installation take?
Installation takes about 30 seconds and is similar to installing a standard cycling cleat.
Is CycloWatt single-sided or dual-sided?
CycloWatt is a single-sided power meter.
How is CycloWatt charged?
CycloWatt uses a magnetic charging connector for easy and reliable charging.
What happens when the cleat wears out?
CycloWatt features a modular design. When the cleat wears out, you can replace only the cleat and keep using the power meter unit.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 2026. This is a pre-launch information page and we keep data collection to a minimum.

Who we are. CycloWatt AG, Switzerland. Contact: levi.luder@cyclowatt.org.

What we collect. If you sign up, we collect the name and email address you enter in the sign-up form. We collect no other personal data on this page.

Why. We use your name and email only to notify you when CycloWatt launches and to send occasional related updates, on the basis of your consent.

How it is processed. The sign-up form and your details are handled by Kit (kit.com), our email provider, who stores and processes this data on our behalf. Your data may be processed on servers outside Switzerland and the EU, including in the United States.

How long. We keep your details until you unsubscribe or until they are no longer needed for the launch, after which they are deleted.

Your choices. You can unsubscribe at any time via the link in every email. You may also request access to, correction or deletion of your data, or withdraw consent, by emailing levi.luder@cyclowatt.org. We never sell your data.
